title: Error with Libre trend
symptom: xDrip Bluetooth collection worked so far, but now the Libre trend does not work anymore. Logs show 'libreBlock exists but no matching bg record exists' and 'BG data was not calculated, working on raw data'. 'Show libre trend' shows 'display error'. Main screen shows three triangles with exclamation marks.
cause: The Libre trend is NFC specific and requires the entire NFC block, which the SweetReader does not provide.
fix: The issue is not resolved; the maintainer suggests that Libre trend works with devices that bring the entire NFC block, such as tomato, librealarm, bluekon (oop mode), and direct phone scans, but not with SweetReader. No fix is provided for SweetReader.
evidence_quote: Libretrend works with everything that brings the entire nfc block always: so it works with tomato, librealarm, bluekon (oop mode) and direct scans by phone.
